login.title: Sign in to your club
login.subtitle: For players: club code and account. Reception works in the browser.
login.memberHint: First time? Create an account with your email. Ask reception if you don’t know the club.
login.ownerHint: Run a club? Reception uses the browser. Players download the app. We open the club with you — it is not an in-app purchase.
login.noClubs: No clubs found. Check that the API is running.
login.apiOfflineHelp: On iPhone: join the same Wi‑Fi (not cellular only) and Settings → PadelApp → Local Network = ON. The server must be running on the Mac.

register.title: Player registration
register.subtitle: Create an account at your club. Then you can book a court.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

home.courtsHint: Indoor / outdoor is the roof type, not whether the court accepts bookings. Book from the calendar.
home.staffHint: Set up this club from the Settings tab. Courts are a list, not a hardcoded number.
home.coachHint: You confirm levels and propose pairings on a full four.
home.playerHint: See open hours on the calendar. Book 1 to 4 names, existing or new.

courts.title: Courts
courts.subtitle: Whatever this club has configured.
courts.empty: This club has no courts yet.
courts.kindHint: Construction type. Indoor = covered. It does not mean the court is closed for play.
courts.playerNote: Hours show on the calendar. Only reception can edit courts.

players.title: Players
players.subtitle: Gender, age and level. The club confirms the level.
players.name: Name
players.selfHint: The player sets this. The club confirms it separately.
players.playerNote: You can change your own level. The club sets the confirmed value.
players.eraseBody: The account and name are removed. Bookings stay on the calendar as “—”. This cannot be undone.
players.eraseHint: Right to erasure of personal data. The club owner cannot be erased here.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.lead: Pick a day — colors match the legend under the calendar.
calendar.noBookingsThisDay: No bookings — tap “All time slots” to book a court.
calendar.noCourts: No active courts for this day.
calendar.playersHint: Pick a club name or type a new one. Empty = hold the court without a team.
calendar.maintenance: This court is in maintenance at this time.

openMatch.title: Open matches
openMatch.lead: Fours looking for a player, within the club’s ±{{delta}}.
openMatch.needLevel: Without a profile level you only see unrated matches.
openMatch.empty: No open matches in the next few days.

more.title: More
more.phaseNote: Pairings and tournaments follow this club’s settings.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.lead: Men, women or mixed (man+woman). Format and scoring come from a club preset.
tournaments.name: Name
tournaments.playDaysHint: Add the days this tournament is played. Weekdays: 17:00–19:15, 19:15–21:30, 21:30–23:45. Weekends: 09:00 through 00:00.
tournaments.needPlayDay: Add at least one play day.
tournaments.availableAll: I confirm I am available all hours
tournaments.availableHint: Otherwise pick up to 8 hours you can play.
tournaments.levelHint: Leave empty for everyone. Or pick a club band.
tournaments.invalidLevel: Level in this club is {{min}} to {{max}}.
tournaments.levelRange: Minimum level cannot be higher than maximum.
tournaments.entriesLocked: A score is in. Players cannot be changed.
tournaments.swapHint: To swap before a score: remove one, add another. An unscored round is cleared — press New round again.
tournaments.groupsHint: Fixed pairs in groups. The top two in each group go to the knockout.
tournaments.kotcHint: Pairs stay together. Winners move one court up, losers one down. King winners stay. No draws. No round cap — close the match when time is up.
tournaments.scoreSaved: Score saved. Club Elo levels were updated.

errors.network: Could not reach the API. On a physical iPhone use the Mac’s LAN address, not 127.0.0.1.
errors.email_taken: This email already has an account at this club.
errors.password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.slot_duration_not_allowed: This slot length is not allowed for the club.
errors.already_on_booking: That player is already on the booking.
errors.cancel_too_late: Too late to cancel under this club’s rule.
errors.waitlist_disabled: The waitlist is off for this club.
errors.level_required: Set a level on your profile before joining an open match.
errors.level_out_of_range: Your level is outside this club’s ± range.
errors.not_on_booking: You are not on this booking.
errors.pairing_need_four: You need four players to make pairings.
errors.pairing_invalid_override: That pairing swap is not valid.
errors.pairing_not_four: Swap only works on a four.
errors.pairing_override_disabled: Pairing override is off for this club.
errors.pairing_need_mixed: Mixed doubles needs at least two men and two women.
errors.cannot_erase_owner: The club owner cannot be erased.
errors.entries_locked: Entries lock once a score is saved.
errors.round_unscored: Enter the score before opening the next round.
errors.pairing_need_replace: Choose which pair the player joins.
errors.gender_missing: Gender is missing on the profile. This category will not accept them without it.
errors.gender_mismatch: The profile gender does not match this category (men / women / mixed).
errors.age_missing: Birth year is missing on the profile. This category has an age limit.
errors.age_mismatch: The profile age is outside this category’s age limit.
errors.level_missing: Level is missing on the profile. This category has a level limit.
errors.level_mismatch: The profile level is outside this category’s level limit.
errors.need_choice: Confirm all hours or pick up to 8 hours you can play.
errors.too_many: You can pick at most 8 hours you can play.
errors.play_slots_required: Add at least one play day with valid hours.
errors.slot_not_in_tournament: That availability slot is not in this tournament.

settings.saved: Saved. Calendar and tournaments will follow these values.
settings.missing: This club has no settings yet.

hub.lead: Settings for this business. There is no second club inside the app.
hub.courtsNote: Courts (1 up to however many you need) live on the Courts tab, not as a number here.

slots.title: Slots
slots.body: The timetable is fixed: 09:30–23:00 every 30 minutes. Here you only set match length (60/90/120), not the grid.

booking.title: Bookings
booking.waitlistHint: When a four is full, extras join the waitlist.

levels.title: Levels
levels.body: Bands belong to the club, not a world ranking. After a match’s first score, Elo writes a confirmed club level.
levels.eloKHint: How fast a level moves after a score (8–64). Applied on the first score only.

openMatch.title: Open match
openMatch.body: Level filter and how many can be missing are set here, not in code.

presets.title: Tournament presets
presets.body: Each club has its own presets. Format and scoring are separate fields.
presets.name: Name
presets.deleteBody: At least one preset must remain.

features.title: Extra features
features.body: Off in v1. Stored now so later screens do not hardcode them.
